D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Fourier.AdvectionClosureInstance.fluid_gap_from_mixed
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.signature: theorem fluid_gap_from_mixed (nu : ℝ) : acceleration nu 1 1 (0, 1) 0 - acceleration nu 1 0 (0, 1) 0 = -Complex.I / 4

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Fourier.AdvectionClosureInstance.mixed_condition_fails
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.signature: theorem mixed_condition_fails : ¬ (∀ a b : State, P a = a → P b = 0 → P (B a b + B b a) = 0)

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Fourier.AdvectionClosureInstance.mixed_witness
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.signature: theorem mixed_witness : P (family 1 0) = family 1 0 ∧ P (family 0 1) = 0 ∧ P (B (family 1 0) (family 0 1) + B (family 0 1) (family 1 0)) 0 0 = Complex.I / 4

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Fourier.AdvectionClosureInstance.no_exact_closure
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.signature: theorem no_exact_closure (nu : ℝ) : ¬ ∃ f : State → State, ∀ x, P (vectorField (L nu) B x) = f (P x)

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Fourier.AdvectionClosureInstance.no_fluid_predictor_from_mixed
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Fourier/AdvectionClo.signature: theorem no_fluid_predictor_from_mixed (nu : ℝ) : ¬ ∃ predict : (Mode → Amplitude) → ℂ, ∀ alpha beta : ℝ, predict (lowObservation alpha beta) = acceleration nu alpha beta (0, 1) 0
